title: Scientific Director
bio: Lawrence leads and operationalizes HDSI-funded scientific programs, including external alliances, and oversees the Trust in Science project. Lawrence’s professional mission has been to bridge the chasm between early-stage research findings and commercial development. He has extensive experience in biomedical research, scientific management, entrepreneurial ventures, and consulting. He was an Assistant Professor at Massachusetts General Hospital,...
